caveat: What is measured is agreement between the extractor and a reference built from two other models that labelled the same text blind. It does not measure agreement with the law as a planner would read it: three models reading the same ambiguous table the same wrong way is invisible to this method.
reliance_notice: This is a research dataset, not a legal determination. Before relying on any answer, at every grade, get a zoning verification letter or use determination from the planning department, or a land-use attorney or planner.
